matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Defense vs. Pass Offense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass defense grades 90/100 (among the NFL's best) against LV's pass offense at 68/100 (above average) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here we are at Gillette for an afternoon date with Las Vegas, and if there's one thing that jumps off the page, it's our pass defense (90/100) getting to feast on a Raiders pass offense that grades at a pedestrian 68/100—the widest statistical mismatch on the board this week. The problem? Our run defense is borderline catastrophic at 23/100 going up against a Raiders rush that, mercifully, is somehow worse at 3/100, so there's a silver lining in mutual incompetence. What should terrify us is their pass rush (90/100) meeting our pass protection (35/100) and their secondary (87/100) facing our passing game (29/100)—we're getting attacked where we're softest. We're 2-2, they're 3-1, we're favored by 3.5, and the last four times we've seen each other, we've won exactly once. The throwback uniforms are coming out for this one, which is either a good omen or a cruel joke depending on how cynical you're feeling.
